title: Six elements and omni
hook: **Elements** are real matchups — fire, ice, air, earth, light, dark, plus **omni** as the all-elements baseline — not flavour labels on a sheet.

blindSpots.meaning: A combat type on the creature and the hit. Six concrete colours plus omni — not a class and not a rarity.
The cycle fire → ice → earth → air → fire. That is the matchup story for those four.
The baseline “all elements” case — not a seventh colour you farm like fire essence.
A creature can carry up to two elements. Traits like void or chaos are traits — they are not extra ring colours.
Cross pairs outside the ring story (and outside light↔dark) stay neutral — no invented third wheel.

alsoTrue: The same ring reads on the lawn and in later battles — one fight language.
Essence colours line up with these elements when you fuse — see [essence](essence).

sections.title: What it is
paras: Matchups are real numbers in combat feedback. Raising a demon’s element at home means something when you field it.

sections.title: How the ring works
sections.intro: Four colours chase each other. Light and dark stand aside:
sections.note: This is not a second ring and invents no new elements. Named combo recipes on top of it are [Vision](named-reactions).

groups.title: On sheets and in fights
groups.intro: Element shows wherever combat and roster care.
steps: Open a specimen sheet and read its element(s).
Field and fight with matchups in mind — lawn or web battle.
Watch combat feedback when a hit lands soft or hard for the colour story.
groups.note: Exact multipliers are balance surface. Trust what the UI shows that day.

doSteps: Pick a specimen and name its element out loud.
Remember the ring: fire melts ice, ice cracks earth, earth blocks air, air blows out fire.
Treat light and dark as a private duel — not part of that four-colour chase.
doNote: Next depth: how hits absorb and crit — [shields, crit, and resistance](shields-crit-resist).

mixUps.q: Is omni a seventh essence colour?
mixUps.a: No. Omni is the baseline all-elements case in combat. Essence stock is the six colours — see [essence](essence).

mixUps.q: Do void or chaos sit on the ring?
mixUps.a: No. Those are traits, not extra elements.

mixUps.q: Does the lawn use a different type chart?
mixUps.a: No. Lawn and later battles share this combat language.

mixUps.q: Can a creature have more than two elements?
mixUps.a: No. Up to two types. Beyond that you are looking at traits or statuses.

mixUps.q: Is this the same as named reactions?
mixUps.a: No. The ring is shipped matchups. Named recipes on top of it are Vision — see [named reactions](named-reactions).
